title: Claims Manual: Valuables Floater Loss Reporting Period and Police Report
content:
Claims manual, Larkspur Valuables Floater: reporting a loss.

## 1. The reporting period

A loss is covered only when it is reported no later than the claim reporting period that starts on the date the loss was discovered. The claim reporting period is counted in calendar days from the discovery date, and a report on the last day is on time.

- **The clock starts** on the date the loss was discovered, which is recorded as the claim's loss date. That date is the one the named insured gives for the claim, and it is tied to the claim number under which the loss is reported.
- **Length.** The period is the tier's claim reporting period in calendar days.
- **Last day.** The last day of the period is the date that falls that many calendar days after the discovery date. A report made on or before the last day is on time; a report made after it is not, and the loss is not covered.
- **The report date** is the date the claim is reported to Larkspur.

## 2. Police report for theft and mysterious disappearance

A theft or mysterious disappearance additionally needs a police report made within the tier's police report window of hours of discovery, or it is denied with the reason no police report.

This is in addition to the reporting period: a theft or mysterious disappearance reported on time is still denied without a police report made within the window.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Tier | Loss discovered | Last day of the period | Reported | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Preferred (60 days) | 1 March | 30 April | 30 April | on time |
| Valuables Floater Preferred (60 days) | 1 March | 30 April | 1 May | late; not covered |
| Valuables Floater Collector (90 days) | 1 March | 30 May | 30 May | on time |
| Valuables Floater Collector (90 days) | 1 March | 30 May | 31 May | late; not covered |

## Theft cases (hypothetical, 72-hour window)

| Circumstance | Result |
|---|---|
| Theft discovered, police report made 30 hours later, claim reported within the period | police report requirement met |
| Mysterious disappearance discovered, police report made 5 days later | denied, reason no police report |
| Theft discovered, no police report made | denied, reason no police report |
